text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"It presents the argument in a more recognizable essay structure with distinct introduction, supporting body paragraphs, and a closing restatement."},{"evidence":"states support for development and gives three reasons up front","quality":"thesis and focus","description":"It makes its position and main claims clear early so the essay stays centered on one argument."},{"evidence":"explains fuel savings, safety measures, and advancing technology","quality":"development of reasoning","description":"It develops each point with explanation rather than just asserting that driverless cars are good."},{"evidence":"includes quoted evidence with paragraph references","quality":"textual support","description":"It more consistently uses details from the article to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"connects evidence to broader effects like affordability and emergency travel","quality":"elaboration","description":"It goes beyond quoting the article by explaining why the facts matter for drivers and society."},{"evidence":"more formal, sustained tone throughout","quality":"academic tone","description":"Its language is generally more appropriate for an argumentative essay and less conversational or abrupt."}]}
